rule: Exclude the whole possession when identified as a clock-driven final scoring attempt at the end of a quarter. Apply regardless of goal, turnover, completion, or whether the source records a huck. Retain pull/centering labels and all original events for audit. Apply to the same comparison metrics and their denominators, including huck attempt percentage, huck timing/completion, throw counts and scoring. Never renumber later possessions.
coverage: Reviewed examples only; a complete league-wide screen remains unfinished. A low clock is a review clue, not automatic exclusion.
